# Waste Institute

> Professional waste management courses, certifications, and training programs from industry experts. Covering waste legislation, circular economy, hazardous waste handling, clinical waste management, and sustainability.

## About

Waste Institute is a professional education platform providing industry-leading waste management courses and certifications. We offer training across all waste management sectors including healthcare waste, hazardous materials, recycling, circular economy, and environmental compliance. Our courses are designed by industry experts and recognized by professionals worldwide.

## Courses

- [Browse all courses](https://wasteinstitute.org/courses)
- Courses range from beginner to advanced levels
- Topics include: Healthcare Waste Management, Hazardous Waste Handling, Circular Economy, Waste Legislation, Recycling Operations, Environmental Compliance, Clinical Waste Audit, Sharps Management
- Professional certifications available upon course completion
- Online, self-paced learning

## Membership

- [Membership levels](https://wasteinstitute.org/membership)
- Student (Free), Affiliate (£97/yr), Associate (£147/yr), Technical (£197/yr), Chartered (£297/yr), Fellowship (invitation only)
- Members receive course discounts, resources, and professional recognition
